about: Hand overrides for the homes of the earlier seasons' country map clubs (scripts/lib/season-club-homes.mjs), by country and the name the season's source gives the club: `as` names today's map's club it is (its home and crest), else `lon`/`lat` with a `note` saying where the point is and why, or `qid` a Wikidata item. Each fixes a name the automatic matching cannot settle: a name two clubs could carry, or one it gives a namesake.

FC Flyeralarm Admira.note: Admira Wacker under its sponsor's name (FIFA 20 to FIFA 22)

Cangzhou Mighty Lions.note: Cangzhou (GeoNames 1816080): the club moved there from Shijiazhuang in 2021, its name since; Wikidata's point is its old ground

Hebei CFFC.note: Langfang (GeoNames 1804540), whose stadium Hebei China Fortune played in from 2018

Paris.note: EA FC 26's Paris is Paris FC, not Paris Saint-Germain

ATK Mohun Bagan.note: Kolkata, as today's Mohun Bagan Super Giant

Tokyo.note: FC Tokyo (Morishige, Nagatomo), not Tokyo Verdy

Yokohama.note: Yokohama FC (FIFA 21 and FIFA 22: Matsuo, Tezuka), not Yokohama F. Marinos

Viitorul.note: FC Viitorul Constanța, whose ground at Ovidiu today's Farul Constanța plays at since the clubs merged in 2021; not Viitorul Domnești

Al Ahli SFC.note: Al-Ahli of Jeddah under EA FC 26's name

R. Sporting.note: Real Sporting de Gijón under EA FC 25's short name

RC Deportivo.note: RC Deportivo de La Coruña under EA FC 25's short name
